goal: Close page256 visual/responsive/interaction/AX evidence using the same two project tabs with minimal retained browser state.
hard_prerequisites: For post-write acceptance, normal page264 release/handoff and fresh page256 saved-data reconciliation already occurred.
Existing reference and target Opera tabs are available/released. If not, STOP; do not open replacements.
Before each evidence read verify the actual URL/anchor because prior connector navigation can move shared tabs.

memory_contract.tab_use: one reference + one target reused for all anchors/viewports
memory_contract.screenshots: at most one tight source and one tight target capture for the currently selected component; discard/advance before next component
memory_contract.AX: literal/section-local subtree only; never retain/paginate whole-page AX unless the exact blocker cannot be isolated
memory_contract.reload: normally none; maximum one deliberate clean reload per side for a stateful interaction sequence; disconnect/504 => STOP, no loop
memory_contract.viewport: change the same two tabs; finish all checks at a viewport before moving to the next
memory_contract.reset: restore active review tab/FAQ state after each interaction sequence

visual: health and technology CTA computed state
desktop_order_one_anchor_at_a_time.decision: If both CTAs already render source-equivalent, PASS/no write despite class-name difference; otherwise only the proven divergent button owner may get a page-local override.

AX: Panasonic points list1/items3 if semantic candidate ran
measure: first media-box ratio should be source 1.78 before any geometry override
interactions: new active panel focus source-equivalent or blocker remains

visual: p1+p2 left composition and forest card right after page-local visual block
AX: physical reading order p1 -> p2 -> article/list before exact PASS

visual: tight icon badge comparison for size/shape/orientation/color/offset
desktop_order_one_anchor_at_a_time.decision: Icon badge exact => PASS_PRESERVE; only a concrete reproduced icon geometry delta permits later icon override.

desktop_order_one_anchor_at_a_time.dependency: TABLE_TITLE_VISUAL is checked only after TABLE_TITLE structure and page-local style carrier PASS.

visual: only after structure PASS: left white article/right sage article geometry and watermark/check/cross/link
desktop_order_one_anchor_at_a_time.rule: If one-shot owner transform has not passed, do not waste screenshot memory trying to close exact expectations visuals; record blocker and move on.

visual: fourth wave only if dependency ran
AX: CTA H2 not contaminated by eyebrow
desktop_order_one_anchor_at_a_time.interaction: Exact source FAQ button/keyboard/motion only if sanctioned runtime owner exists; otherwise native details remains functional but blocker stays OPEN.

checks: mobile h2 winning computed size before any override

measurement_no_write_rules: First review natural image ratio is not a defect; write only if rendered media box itself diverges from source 1.78/contain.
Desktop 39px legacy H2 is source-like; write a fluid clamp only if <=720/~390 winning computed size remains materially source-divergent.
Hero CTA class strings are not acceptance; computed visual/focus state is.
Technology icon subject/order is already protected; geometry must be concretely reproduced as wrong before override.
If a structure hard blocker is still open, do not declare its visual approximation exact.
stop_conditions: target state drift from reconciled saved baseline
ambiguous source/target comparison due zoom/DPR/owner uncertainty
acceptance_rule: No PIXEL_PASS until all required section-local desktop/responsive checks and every semantic/runtime blocker relevant to exactness are freshly closed. No new tabs are permitted merely to finish evidence faster.
